Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Party Cooldowns
- Increased the limit from 12 to 24 abilities per job, with up to three custom rows.
- Updated every job's default ability list: defensives first, then 2-minute cooldowns, then 1-minute cooldowns.
- Defaults focus on protection rather than pure healing or unrelated utility. Other supported abilities remain available to add manually.
- Moved Recitation, Seraphism, and Philosophia into the defensive choices.
- Existing ability selections and custom rows are preserved. Use Reset [job] to load that job's new defaults.

Layout
- Added a Default button beside the layout Reset. It restores the selected side's default size, spacing, and position without changing ability selections or cooldown timers.
- New installations start on the left using the updated layout.
- Existing users keep their saved side and layout settings.
- Reset remains offsets-only.

Fixes and Help
- Fixed Ninja's default Dream Within a Dream selection not showing Assassinate when level-synced below its upgrade.
- Updated the Walkthrough, Help Center, and documentation for the 24-ability limit and new defaults.
